decision.rationale: Defer all source-level Glide changes for the current pinned Phase0–2 proof. The requested D998/e783 evidence is immutable, and all 23 app-variant assemblies, all 23 unit suites, and the selected API 35 synthetic runtime pass on the current proof. The terminal full root build nevertheless exited 1 with BUILD FAILED after 5h34m44 and exactly two task failures: the Glide duplicate in :demo:image-editor and an undeclared color resource in :lib:video. A :lib:signal-glide split would create a new source baseline, needs a separate image-editor DecryptableUri behavior decision, and cannot fix the independent video failure. This is a scope, provenance, and behavior-preservation decision, not a time or effort shortcut. Keep the full root result failed; retain the module split only as a future recommendation if separately authorized.

deferrals.reason: The current proof is specifically anchored to immutable D998/e783 source evidence; all 23 assemblies, 23 unit suites, and the selected API 35 runtime pass on that proof. A source change would establish a new baseline and require fresh replay, runtime decisions for image-editor DecryptableUri support, and a full matrix. This is a provenance and compatibility boundary, not an effort-based shortcut.
